book.name: John
book.title: Rongmwehu ma Insingdi jang ipen John

content: Koapwoapwoaud Oau Nehn Cana
Mwerin rehn riau, koapwoapwoaud oau wiawi nehn koaujoan Cana, nehn Galilee; inen Jesus‑o pel pwili mine wijahu.
Jesus apel nah sohnpadahkkok pel lukkoang in koapwoapwoauddo.
Nehn anjoauwo ma nimarai wainnok roj; inen Jesus‑o pwehng Ih, “Roj nimarai wain.”
Jesus japoang,

content.text: “Joah pwehng Ngoahi da Ngoahi en wia. Oai anjoau kahjikkoar leldo.”

content: Doari, inahu pwehng jounpapah kan liduhwok, “Kamwai wiahda meohroj ma Ih pirin pwehng kamwai.”
Doari, dohn pil sakai koalik wonou ma wiahla jang sakai mine wijahu, mihn kamwkel, siahk in loapin lamlam in mihn Jew‑ok, ma kak audohdkihda nehn pwungen kalen rieijek ke jilihjek.
Jesus pwehng jounpapah kan,
Jounpapah kan ken audohda oaroh dir.
Ih pwehng irai,

content.text: “Kamwai idipda wahla ipen koaun in kamdippwe.”

content: Irai ken wahla.
Koaun in kamdippwo jong pillo ma ne wiahla wain, a ih pwen jehjoa ia wija ma wainno injang. A jounpapah kan ma idipda pillo, irai ioar ma kidal. Koaun in kamdippwo ken pangindo woal kamwohddo,
pwehng, “Armaj ohroj kin kihda oh mijoa wain mwehu; a mwuhr, nehn sohn kamdippwo irai kin jakaula, irai kapwa kihda wain joah nohn mwehu. A koawoa neknekiddoar wain mwehuwo oaroh lel anjoaukije!”
Ioar me sapin kilel kan
ma Jesus wiahda nehn Cana nehn Galilee, a ioar doahroar Ah kajalehda Ah ling; doari, Nah sohnpadahkkok ken pwojonla.
Mwerin me, Jesus inlahng Capernaum, pwilihkihla inahu, riah woallok, apel Nah sohnpadahkkok, irai minmine wijahu oaroain rehn pwi.
Jesus Inlahng Umw Joarwiho
Nehn anjoau in Joarwihn Passover ne koaroando, Jesus ken inlahng Jerusalem.
Ih kapangda in Umw Joarwiho woal pwi ma kin noaski kahu, jihpw apel mwurei, apel epwi sohnkawiliali mwani, minmine in arai sehpillok.
Ih ken wiahkihda mihn pokpok joal pwi, Ih ken kaujjang irai in Umw Joarwiho, pwilihki jihpw apel kahu ohroj. Ih ken ukuddi en sohnkawiliali mwanihok arai sehpillok apel wudekihdi nihrai mwanihok.
Ih pwehng irai ma kin noaskihla mwureiok,

content.text: “Kamwai wahlahjang mehpwiai me, a joah wiahki umwen Joamoaihe umwen noas oau!”

content: Nah sohnpadahkkok ken lemehda da ma insingdi nehn Puk Joarwiho, “Maing Koahs, oai kajampwalki Umwoammwe kin okkokkok nehn mohngiongihoa doahroar oai.”
Koaun in mihn Jew‑ok idoak ipoa, “Kilel da ma Koawoa kak en wiahda ma pirin kajalehioang kamai ma Koawoa anki manman in wia mehpwiai?”
Jesus japoang,

content.text: “Kamwai koauwehla Umwen Koahs oauwe, a mwerin rehn jiluh Ngoahi pel pirin pwuroahng kouda.”

content: Mihn Jew‑ok pel kalelpoak, “Koawoa pirin pwuroahng kouda rehn jiluhoar? Johnpar pahijek wonou ma Umw Joarwi oauwe kokoukihda!”
A ummwo ma Ih pwahpwahpwa, ioar pein palwoaroa.
Nehn Ah iejda jang mehdi, Nah sohnpadahkkok ken samanda da Ih pwahkihla mehpwiai; apel irai ken pwojonla lal in Puk Joarwi apel en Jesus padahk kan.
Jesus Kidal Armaj Ohroj
Doari, nehn ah minmine Jerusalem nehn anjoau in Joarwihn Passover, dir armaj pwojonla Ih nehn irai kapangda kilel kan ma Ih kin wiahda.
A Jesus johpwa likihoang irai pein Ih, pwa Ih kidal armaj ohroj.
Johpwa anahne emen en kadehdehng Jesus doahroar armaj kan, pwa pein Ih kidal joang dahpwi ma kin mine nehn mohngiongirai.

footnotes.text: Kilel kan Jouninsing mene kin doadoahkki loapin sikesik pase “Kilel” ma woahwoahki manman kapwuriamwei ma Jesus wiahda pwa mwoakid pwiai kin wia kilelin pwa Ih Nihn Koahs.
